name: Filter — date
description: Branches pass / fail. Compare the source date against a value, range, or rolling window. Engine operators: equals, before, after, between, within_last, within_next, plus is_null. Authoring also supports calendar predicates (day-of-week, weekend, month-of-year) that compile down to a calc filter at save time.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The date you want to check — pick a date field from the request (e.g. departure, booking, dateOfBirth).

params.name: operator
params.description: How to test the source date.

enum.label: ≠ not equal
enum.description: Source differs from a specific date.

enum.label: < before
enum.description: Source is strictly before a date.

enum.label: > after
enum.description: Source is strictly after a date.

enum.label: within last N
enum.description: Source falls in [now - amount × unit, now].

enum.label: within next N
enum.description: Source falls in [now, now + amount × unit].

enum.label: is null
enum.description: Pass when the source is null / missing.

params.name: match
params.description: The match config — single date, range, or rolling window. Authored via the calendar picker, which adapts to the chosen operator.

params.name: granularity
params.description: How precisely to compare. Most rules want 'date' (ignore time of day).

enum.label: Date only
enum.description: Strip the time component before comparing.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for the comparison (IANA name, e.g. 'Europe/London'). Default UTC.

params.name: fromInclusive
params.description: For between / not_between: treat 'from' as inclusive. Default true.

params.name: toInclusive
params.description: For between / not_between: treat 'to' as inclusive. Default true.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source date isn't in the request.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on.
